caption: A bowl of miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with tender noodles. Topped with a square of nori and chopped green onions, it sits in a white ceramic bowl, viewed from above under warm, ambient light against a dark wooden table.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, slightly reflective near the glass.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, square-shaped, with a slightly uneven surface and visible frilly edges.
The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and steaming, swirling around noodles and garnishes with visible bubbles and steam.
The bowl is light beige ceramic, smooth with subtle surface wear, featuring a slightly uneven, rounded rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly glossy surface and rounded bowl shape.
